card.capacity_status_quote: The advanced lines are filling up. And some of these areas, are getting to levels of high utilization.
card.demand_direction_quote: Amkor delivered record first quarter revenue of $1.68 billion, increasing 27% year-on-year. Revenue was above the midpoint of guidance, driven by stronger-than-expected performance across all end markets, except computing, where we saw softness in PCs and laptops.
card.pricing_power_quote: So we expect to see pricing will kind of increase as we go throughout the year. So that will just help offset some of these cost increases that we're seeing on the material side.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We remain confident in the full year outlook we provided last quarter, with revenue growth driven by acceleration in computing, and strong growth in advanced automotive.
card.constraint_owner_quote: Some customer supply materials are being delayed, causing nonlinear loading.
